content.title: ‘Dateline - The murder of Bob Lee’: Where to watch (for free) in case you missed it
content.text: Updated: Mar. 20, 2026, 4:49 p.m.Published: Mar. 20, 2026, 4:49 p.m.Dateline NBCDateline NBCIf you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation.“Dateline” is taking a look at the murder of Bob Lee, the businessman who created Cash App. You can stream the latest episode of “Dateline” and all previous episodes, including the Lori Vallow Daybell jailhouse interview, the death of Ashley Schwalm, and The Terrible Night on King Road, on either of the following streaming services:The episode airs on Friday, March 20 at 9 p.m.(Fubo is currently in a protracted contract dispute with NBC and may not be a valid option to watch.)This 41-minute-long episode is a report by Dateline’s Josh Mankiewicz and presented by Lester Holt.Here’s a look at the “Dateline” coverage of the mysterious death of young mother Ashley Schwalm:Where to watch ‘Dateline’ for free?“Under the Bay Bridge” is the 18th episode of season 34 of “Dateline.” There are several free trials you can use to watch this episode of “Dateline.” DirecTV has a 5-day free trial, and Fubo TV, which may not carry NBC when the episode airs, has a 5-day free trial you can sign up for. Or, you can sign up for Peacock for $8/month (no free trial) and keep up to date with all of “Dateline,” like other famous episodes, including The Mystery of Sarah Hartsfield, The Terrible Night on King Road, The Menendez Brothers: Chance At Freedom, and The Night of the Nor’easter.Streaming ServicePriceFree Trial?Peacock$8/monthNoDIRECTV (free trial)$75/monthYes, 5 daysWhen is ‘NBC Dateline’ on?“Dateline” airs new episodes on Fridays on NBC at 9/8c, along with special extra episodes on select Sundays. New episodes are available the next day after they air on the Peacock app. The show has recently aired coverage like “Sean Combs on Trial," with an episode about Bryan Kohberger from the Friday before. NBC’s “Dateline” has been on the air since 1992 and is currently presented by Lester Holt.
